natural: Turning danger into safety

meaning.en: To turn danger into safety; to avert a crisis.
meaning.zh: 使危险的情况或处境变为平安。

examples.zh: 机长沉着应对，最终化险为夷。
examples.en: The captain stayed calm and averted disaster.

examples.zh: 多亏你及时提醒，我们才化险为夷。
examples.en: Thanks to your timely warning, we pulled through.

natural: Working one's jaws with great delight

meaning.en: To eat heartily and with great enjoyment.
meaning.zh: 痛痛快快地大吃一顿。

examples.zh: 来到成都，一定要大快朵颐一番。
examples.en: When you come to Chengdu, you must have a proper feast.

examples.zh: 一家人围着火锅大快朵颐。
examples.en: The family gathered round the hotpot and tucked in.

story.en: The Book of Changes uses 朵颐 for moving one's jaws when eating: "watching me move my jaws" (观我朵颐).
story.zh: 《周易·颐》："舍尔灵龟，观我朵颐。""朵颐"指鼓动腮颊嚼食。

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前9—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 9th–3rd c. BC

usage.zh: 多作谓语，美食文章常用。

natural: Looking for a fine horse by following a picture

meaning.en: To follow a guide mechanically (often negative); also to follow clues to find something.
meaning.zh: 按照图像寻找好马。比喻办事机械，拘泥成法；也比喻按照线索寻找。

examples.zh: 学习不能按图索骥，要学会灵活运用。
examples.en: Don't just follow the textbook mechanically — learn to apply it flexibly.

examples.zh: 警方按图索骥，很快找到了嫌疑人。
examples.en: Following the leads, the police quickly found the suspect.

story.en: The son of the great horse-judge Bole studied his father's manual — "a high forehead, bulging eyes" — and came back with a toad.
story.zh: 伯乐之子拿着《相马经》按"额头隆起，双目突出"去找千里马，结果找回一只癞蛤蟆。

usage.en: Predicate. Two senses: rigidly following rules (critical) or following clues (neutral).
usage.zh: 多作谓语。既可贬指拘泥，也可中性地指按线索寻找。

natural: Building a cart behind closed doors

meaning.en: To work in isolation without regard to reality.
meaning.zh: 关起门来造车。比喻只凭主观办事，不管客观实际。

examples.zh: 产品设计不能闭门造车，要多听用户意见。
examples.en: Product design can't happen in a vacuum — listen to users.

examples.zh: 这份政策是闭门造车的结果，根本行不通。
examples.en: The policy was drawn up in an ivory tower and simply doesn't work.

story.en: The saying was originally "build the cart behind closed doors, and it fits the ruts outside" (闭门造车，出门合辙) — i.e. good standards work everywhere. The modern idiom drops the second half and reverses the sense.
story.zh: 原作"闭门造车，出门合辙"，指按统一规格造车，出门就合车辙。后多用前半句，意义变为贬义。

literal: go out · you · come back · you
natural: What goes out from you comes back to you

meaning.en: To go back on one's word; to say one thing and then do another.
meaning.zh: 原指你怎样对待别人，别人就怎样对待你。现指说了又反悔，言行前后矛盾。

examples.zh: 说好的事情他又出尔反尔。
examples.en: He's gone back on his word again.

examples.zh: 做生意最忌出尔反尔。
examples.en: In business, the worst thing you can do is break your word.

story.en: Mencius quotes Zengzi: "Beware! What goes out from you will come back to you" (出乎尔者，反乎尔者也) — how you treat others is how they treat you.
story.zh: 曾子曰："戒之戒之！出乎尔者，反乎尔者也。"

usage.en: Predicate. Today means going back on one's word, not the original "reap what you sow".
usage.zh: 多作谓语。现义为反复无常。

natural: Worn out by running about under orders

meaning.en: Run off one's feet; exhausted by constant demands.
meaning.zh: 原指因奉命奔走而疲劳不堪。后也指忙于应付，非常劳累。

examples.zh: 这个月客户太多，大家疲于奔命。
examples.en: There've been so many clients this month that we're all run off our feet.

examples.zh: 他每天在几份兼职之间疲于奔命。
examples.en: He's run ragged every day juggling several part-time jobs.

natural: With a fierce, menacing air

meaning.en: Aggressive and menacing; furious.
meaning.zh: 形容盛怒时声势很凶猛。

examples.zh: 他气势汹汹地冲进办公室要说法。
examples.en: He stormed into the office on the warpath, demanding an explanation.

examples.zh: 台风气势汹汹地扑向沿海。
examples.en: The typhoon bore down furiously on the coast.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. 汹 is xiōng.

natural: Somewhat lifting one's spirits

meaning.en: Passable; just about satisfactory. (Often misused to mean unsatisfactory.)
meaning.zh: 大体上还能使人满意。

examples.zh: 这次考试成绩差强人意，还有提高空间。
examples.en: The exam results are passable, but there's room to improve.

examples.zh: 新产品的销量差强人意。
examples.en: Sales of the new product are just about satisfactory.

story.en: When others despaired after a defeat, General Wu Han calmly prepared for battle. Emperor Guangwu said: "General Wu somewhat lifts one's spirits" (吴公差强人意).
story.zh: 诸将战败惶恐，吴汉却从容整顿兵器。光武帝说："吴公差强人意，隐若一敌国矣。"

usage.en: Predicate. 差 is chā (somewhat). Strictly means "fairly satisfactory", though many speakers use it for "disappointing".
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"差"读 chā，意为"稍微"。本义为"大体满意"，常被误用为"不满意"。

natural: Talent and grace at their height

meaning.en: In the prime of youth, full of talent and vigour.
meaning.zh: 风采才华正当旺盛之时。形容青年朝气蓬勃。

examples.zh: 一群风华正茂的大学生走进了校园。
examples.en: A group of bright young students walked onto the campus.

examples.zh: 回想起风华正茂的岁月，他感慨万千。
examples.en: Recalling the days of his youth, he was flooded with emotion.

story.en: From Mao Zedong's 1925 poem: "We were young classmates, our talents just in flower" (恰同学少年，风华正茂).
story.zh: 毛泽东《沁园春·长沙》："恰同学少年，风华正茂。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. About young people.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，用于青年。

natural: Clearing thorns and hacking through brambles

meaning.en: To overcome obstacles and blaze a trail.
meaning.zh: 劈开荆棘，扫除障碍。比喻克服创业中的重重困难。

examples.zh: 他们披荆斩棘，开创了一番事业。
examples.en: They overcame every obstacle to build a business.

examples.zh: 先辈们披荆斩棘，为我们创造了今天的生活。
examples.en: Our forebears blazed the trail and made today's life possible.

story.en: Emperor Guangwu introduced General Feng Yi to his court: "This is the man who cleared the thorns and brambles for me and pacified the Guanzhong region" (为吾披荆棘，定关中).
story.zh: 光武帝向群臣介绍冯异："是我起兵时主簿也，为吾披荆棘，定关中。"

usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于开创事业。

natural: Judging the whole by a part

meaning.en: To generalise from a part to the whole; to over-generalise.
meaning.zh: 用片面的观点看待整体问题。

equivalents: one swallow doesn't make a summer
tar everyone with the same brush

examples.zh: 遇到一个坏人就说这个城市的人都不好，是以偏概全。
examples.en: Meeting one bad person and saying everyone in the city is bad is over-generalising.

examples.zh: 写议论文要避免以偏概全。
examples.en: Argumentative essays must avoid sweeping generalisations.

usage.en: Predicate or object. Common in critical thinking and essays.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，议论文常用。

natural: All previous effort thrown away

meaning.en: All previous efforts are wasted.
meaning.zh: 以前的功劳全部丢失。也指以前的努力全部白费。

examples.zh: 减肥最怕反弹，一放松就前功尽弃。
examples.en: The worst thing about dieting is the rebound — relax once and it's all for nothing.

examples.zh: 坚持到最后，别让前功尽弃。
examples.en: Hang on to the end — don't let all that effort go to waste.

story.en: Su Li warned the Qin general Bai Qi, after many victories, not to attack Liang: "if one move fails, all your earlier merit is lost" (一举不得，前功尽灭).
story.zh: 苏厉劝白起："今公又以秦兵出塞，过两周，践韩而以攻梁，一攻而不得，前功尽灭。"

natural: Home destroyed and family dead

meaning.en: One's family ruined and its members dead or scattered.
meaning.zh: 家庭破落，亲人死亡。形容家遭不幸的悲惨景象。

examples.zh: 战争让无数人家破人亡。
examples.en: The war left countless families torn apart and dead.

examples.zh: 他因赌博欠下巨债，落得家破人亡。
examples.en: His gambling debts ruined his family.

usage.en: Predicate. Very strong; war, disaster, addiction.

natural: Embracing ten thousand things

meaning.en: All-embracing; covering everything.
meaning.zh: 内容丰富，应有尽有。

examples.zh: 这本百科全书包罗万象。
examples.en: This encyclopedia covers everything under the sun.

examples.zh: 博物馆展品包罗万象，从恐龙化石到现代艺术都有。
examples.en: The museum's collection is all-encompassing, from dinosaur fossils to modern art.

natural: Gaining without working

meaning.en: To reap without sowing; to gain without working.
meaning.zh: 自己不劳动而占有别人的劳动成果。

examples.zh: 天下没有不劳而获的好事。
examples.en: There's no such thing as a free lunch.

examples.zh: 他总想不劳而获，结果被骗了。
examples.en: He always wanted something for nothing and ended up being conned.

natural: A hundred feelings converging at once

meaning.en: A flood of mixed emotions.
meaning.zh: 各种感触交织在一起，形容感慨万千。

examples.zh: 看着女儿出嫁，他百感交集。
examples.en: Watching his daughter get married, he felt a rush of mixed emotions.

examples.zh: 重回母校，我百感交集。
examples.en: Returning to my old school, I was overwhelmed with emotion.

natural: The country at peace and the people safe

meaning.en: The nation is at peace and the people live in safety.
meaning.zh: 国家太平，人民安乐。

examples.zh: 春节时人们祈求国泰民安、风调雨顺。
examples.en: At Spring Festival people pray for peace, prosperity and good weather.

examples.zh: 只有国泰民安，百姓才能安居乐业。
examples.en: Only when the country is at peace can people live and work contentedly.

usage.en: Predicate. Common in New Year wishes, often with 风调雨顺.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于新年祝福。

natural: Where everyone's hopes converge

meaning.en: The popular choice; enjoying everyone's confidence.
meaning.zh: 大家的信任和希望都归向某人。

examples.zh: 他当选主席，可谓众望所归。
examples.en: His election as chairman was the popular choice.

examples.zh: 这部电影获得最佳影片，众望所归。
examples.en: The film's Best Picture win was well deserved.

natural: Roughly made and carelessly produced

meaning.en: Shoddily made; churned out carelessly.
meaning.zh: 制作粗劣，不讲质量。也指工作马虎，草率从事。

examples.zh: 这些粗制滥造的玩具存在安全隐患。
examples.en: These shoddily made toys are a safety hazard.

examples.zh: 有些网剧粗制滥造，只为赚快钱。
examples.en: Some web dramas are churned out just to make quick money.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Products and creative works.

natural: Lofty mountains and steep ridges

meaning.en: High, steep mountains.
meaning.zh: 高大险峻的山岭。

examples.zh: 长城蜿蜒在崇山峻岭之间。
examples.en: The Great Wall winds through towering mountains.

examples.zh: 铁路穿过崇山峻岭，连接起山区和城市。
examples.en: The railway runs through rugged peaks, linking mountain areas to the city.

story.en: Wang Xizhi's Orchid Pavilion Preface: "Here there are lofty mountains and steep ridges, lush forests and tall bamboo" (此地有崇山峻岭，茂林修竹).
story.zh: 王羲之《兰亭集序》："此地有崇山峻岭，茂林修竹。"

usage.en: Noun phrase; object of 在/穿过.

natural: Rousing every effort to govern well

meaning.en: To strive hard to govern well and make the country prosper.
meaning.zh: 振奋精神，努力治理好国家。

examples.zh: 这位皇帝励精图治，国家日益强盛。
examples.en: The emperor worked tirelessly to govern well, and the country grew stronger every day.

examples.zh: 新领导班子励精图治，公司扭亏为盈。
examples.en: The new leadership strove hard, and the company turned a profit.

natural: Turning black into white

meaning.en: To twist the facts; to call black white.
meaning.zh: 把黑的说成白的，白的说成黑的。比喻歪曲事实，混淆是非。

equivalents: turn the truth on its head

examples.zh: 他颠倒黑白，反说是受害者的错。
examples.en: He twisted the facts and blamed the victim.

examples.zh: 一些媒体颠倒黑白，误导公众。
examples.en: Some media outlets turn the truth on its head and mislead the public.

natural: The gate and courtyard bustling like a market

meaning.en: Thronged with visitors; extremely popular.
meaning.zh: 门前和院子里热闹得像市场一样。形容来的人很多。

examples.zh: 这家网红餐厅门庭若市，要排两小时队。
examples.en: The trendy restaurant is packed — the queue is two hours long.

examples.zh: 他当官时家里门庭若市。
examples.en: When he was in office, visitors constantly thronged his house.

story.en: After Zou Ji persuaded King Wei of Qi to reward criticism, "ministers came to remonstrate until the gate and courtyard were like a market" (群臣进谏，门庭若市).
story.zh: 邹忌讽齐王纳谏，齐王下令，"群臣进谏，门庭若市"。

usage.en: Predicate. Opposite of 门可罗雀.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。反义为"门可罗雀"。

natural: Both sides beaten and both hurt

meaning.en: Both sides lose; a lose-lose outcome.
meaning.zh: 争斗的双方都受到损伤。

examples.zh: 价格战只会两败俱伤。
examples.en: A price war is lose-lose.

examples.zh: 离婚官司打了三年，结果两败俱伤。
examples.en: The divorce dragged on for three years, and nobody won.

natural: Keeping oneself clean and cherishing one's integrity

meaning.en: To keep oneself morally pure; to stay out of corruption.
meaning.zh: 保持自己纯洁，不同流合污。也指怕招惹是非，只顾自己好，不关心公众事情。

examples.zh: 在复杂的环境中，他始终洁身自好。
examples.en: In a murky environment, he always kept his hands clean.

examples.zh: 公众人物更应洁身自好。
examples.en: Public figures should be especially careful about their conduct.

usage.en: Predicate. 好 is hào (to cherish). Can also criticise staying aloof.
